summaryList:

The company imported, sold and/or offered for sale medical device(s) that were not authorised for sale by Health Canada.

Risk 2:
The company did not adequately implement the written procedure for complaint handling.

Risk 2:

data.regulation: MDR s.63.2  Recall notification within 24 hours
summaryList:

The company did not provide one or more 24-hour notifications to Health Canada.

data.regulation: MDR s.64  Timeline requirement for initial recall report
